mcr_muscle_eze.name: Muscle Eze
mcr_muscle_eze.key: Per 3 capsules: 200 mg magnesium (citrate), 100 mg calcium (lactate), 50 mg L-theanine, 40 mg passion flower extract
mcr_muscle_eze.src: Supplement Facts: labels.json entry R884, NutriDyn sell sheet 'Muscle Eze SS ND433' Rev. 7/26 (Dropbox id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAA6G6g): serving 3 capsules, 30 servings, Ca 100 mg (lactate), Mg 200 mg (citrate), L-theanine 50 mg, passion flower extract 40 mg; directions 'Adults take three capsules daily'; caution 'If pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use. Use with caution when driving or operating machinery; may cause drowsiness.' Size R884 90C from ND144 price list Rev. 10.1.26. URL from repo blasts/2026-09-22-muscle-guarding.html. PHOTO: repo blasts/assets/muscle-eze.png, the 254x420 NutriDyn web render with clean label text (about 430 ppi at the sheet's 0.98 in photo height). The 1544 px AI upscale in img-src (R884.png) rewrote the small label text ('Torgotod Formula'), so this sheet does not use it.

mcr_mag_calm_pro.name: Mag Calm Pro
mcr_mag_calm_pro.key: Per scoop: 200 mg magnesium (malate), 500 mg taurine, 2 g myo-inositol, 100 mg L-theanine, 5 mg vitamin B6
mcr_mag_calm_pro.src: Supplement Facts: labels.json entry R2122, NutriDyn sell sheet 'Mag Calm Pro SS ND1075' Rev. 11/24 (Dropbox id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAryEw): about 1 scoop (4.13 g), about 60 servings; B6 (P5P) 5 mg, Mg (dimagnesium malate) 200 mg, myo-inositol 2 g, taurine 500 mg, L-theanine (Suntheanine) 100 mg; directions 'Mix 1 scoop with 6 ounces of water 1-2 times daily'; caution 'If pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use.' Same amounts in the products DB (R2122, Metagenics chart, catalog ND143 10/1/26). Size R2122 247.8 g from ND144 price list Rev. 10.1.26. URL as used by the menopause and stress-cortisol sheets. PHOTO: repo blasts/assets/mag-calm-pro.png (244x265 re-save of the 386x420 render committed in 1beb626), clean label text, about 270 ppi at 0.98 in. The 1508 px AI upscale in img-src (R2122.png) rewrote label words ('Practitionor Exclusive', 'Hoolthy Stress and Relaxation Support'), so this sheet does not use it. Best master to stage: the 386x420 original from git history (1beb626), about 430 ppi.

mcr_vitamin_k2.name: Vitamin K2
mcr_vitamin_k2.key: 100 mcg vitamin K2 as menaquinone-7 (MK-7) per capsule
mcr_vitamin_k2.src: products DB P733 label_facts (Pure Encapsulations, Designs for Health, Thorne and Microbiome Labs switch charts, catalog ND143 10/1/26): vitamin K2 (menaquinone-7) 100 mcg per 1 capsule, no vitamin D; directions 'Take one capsule daily with a meal or as directed by your healthcare practitioner.' P733 30C is the only size on the 10/1/26 price list. The bottle is the Progressive Professional brand ('From Progressive Laboratories' on the label), sold through NutriDyn, like P433 on the gut-overgrowth sheet. URL nutridyn.com/vitamin-k2 seen through web search (the page lists MK-7 100 mcg, 30 capsules, and a warfarin warning); nutridyn.com is blocked from this session, so the page was not opened.
